method: Trace each glyph from the agreement of two prints of the same artwork, not from one print's noise.

constructions.own_acutes_reason: Both prints set each fada as drawn for its letter: on i a short acute (0.43 x-height wide against 0.68 on the others) right of the stem, on o one set right of centre. The composites keep each traced acute and its place across the letter; the gap above the letter stays the builder's uniform one (the traced gaps vary by print). a's acute touches the bowl on both prints, so a takes the shared acute at a's place.
constructions.brace_reason: Braces are not on the specimens. The stroked construction ended the tip inside the stems' outer edge, cutting a notch into the waist; drawn instead with a point.

independent_checks.what: Tuam Uncial Letraset sheet S53912, 48 pt, c. 1980 (production)
independent_checks.where: Bolger 2017 volume 2, PDF page 164; pdfimages JPEG 590 x 900, SHA-256 2ea8c4401b68e2435b080cb37d976347086f1acc404da5194b1488ef50b8b8aa
independent_checks.result: sheet-check.json (scripts/tuam_sheet_check.py): n 9 of 9 impressions in two pieces, h 10 of 10, f 7 of 7, u 13 of 13, r 7 of 8, u-acute 2 of 2 in three; v, w, x, e and o in one (x-height about 20 px: cuts narrower than about two N45 pixels do not separate). The means of the v and w impressions show a light seam at the cut N45 prints; the mean of the x impressions (crossed, not cut) shows none.

limitations: N46 and N45 reproduce the same lettering and may share intermediate copies: their agreement is not independent confirmation. Bolger fig. 206 (the production sheet) is the independent check, at a third of their resolution.
The traced edge is the mean of the two prints at each print's own paper and ink levels.
Legacy builder text-height regularisation and modern extensions remain.
